prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished high-fidelity desktop UI design screenshot for ToolDawn, a multi-purpose AI utility application. 1536x1024 straight-on flat screenshot, no device frame. All interface text MUST be correctly rendered Simplified Chinese, except brand ToolDawn. Direction A: graphite creative workspace. Full-bleed neutral charcoal #181A19 canvas, sidebar #111311, subtle raised surfaces #252825, off-white typography, vivid lime #C8F568 primary actions, muted salmon and icy cyan secondary accents. Not dark blue. Highly intentional typography and measured spacing, restrained 6px radii, hairline borders. Narrow 200px left sidebar: ToolDawn wordmark with small sunrise symbol, navigation '工具广场', '我的收藏', '最近使用', '我的文件'; bottom '设置' and compact user avatar. Compact header breadcrumb '工作空间 / 工具广场', right search icon, '中文' selector, avatar. Main area heading '工具广场' at 28px, top right prominent lime action '上传图片' with upload icon. Wide search field with placeholder '搜索你需要的工具', below filter tabs '全部', '图片处理', '文字写作', '日常生活'. Content is purpose-built unframed layout: left two-thirds tools, right third narrow recent activity column with fine dividers. A large first tool item spans two columns showing landscape photo changing into crisp painted illustration, labeled '照片风格转换' with tiny '热门' badge and compact lime arrow icon; bright visible mountains and lake, never dark or blurred. Adjacent narrow tool '智能抠图' preview a coral sneaker on checkerboard. Below three smaller equally sized tool entries: '文章润色' with a neatly typeset short Chinese document preview, '食物分析' with sharp real lunch photography, '生日祝福' with a tasteful red paper greeting card. Right activity column '最近使用' with thumbnail entries and times '刚刚', '10 分钟前', '昨天'; lower compact file list. No huge hero, no advertising slogan, no glassmorphism, no glow, no gradient blobs, no decorative charts. Actual useful product as first screen. Strong readable Chinese typography and sophisticated visual hierarchy, generous margins but efficient density, photoreal previews carry visual interest. Deliver a complete beautiful cohesive usable interface mockup.

Use case: ui-mockup. Design a premium high fidelity desktop screenshot of ToolDawn, a practical AI tools collection. 1536x1024, straight-on full interface, no browser or laptop frame. Every UI label is Simplified Chinese except brand ToolDawn. Direction B: refined mist-gray and forest green utility library, visually rich but calm. Canvas cool stone gray #E3E8E6, left navigation panel deep forest green #183D34, inner content gray-green #D5DFDA, very limited pale surfaces #F2F4F1 for individual previews only; no pure white page background, not beige or monochrome green. Coral #D56B59 accent and yellow #EBCB63 small status marks. 180px sidebar with prominent ToolDawn logo, compact nav '发现工具', '我的收藏', '使用记录', '文件管理', bottom '设置'. Main content top toolbar with '工具库' breadcrumb, compact search field '搜索工具', language '中文', avatar. Main title '发现工具' at comfortable 30px, category segmented control '全部工具', '图片', '文字', '生活' aligned on same horizontal area. Main center a clean 3 column grid of six repeated tool entries, each thin border, 6px corners, realistic meaningful previews and clearly legible Chinese titles: '智能抠图' shows mustard-colored chair isolated from a room onto checkerboard; '照片风格转换' shows a beautiful pink seaside building transformed into an illustration; '食物分析' shows bright overhead lunch bowl; '文章润色' shows a short Chinese document comparison; '生日祝福' shows a pink floral greeting card on muted red background; '图片压缩' shows the same vivid landscape with small '4.2 MB' and '420 KB' tags. Each entry has neat icon, title, tiny favorite star, simple trailing arrow. Subtle green section labels and coral small accents, not a generic bright white card grid. Below grid show '最近使用' as an unframed horizontal list with thumbnail, filename and '已完成' status. Balanced asymmetry, professional detailed typography, icon consistency, no oversize hero, no marketing copy, no invented statistics, no gradients, no orbs, no nested cards. High end actual web product design with believable Chinese content.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create an outstanding high fidelity ToolDawn desktop AI utility application UI prototype, 1536x1024, front-facing screenshot with no frame. All UI text in accurate Simplified Chinese except ToolDawn brand. Direction C: confident warm-gray creative tools gallery with coral red and cobalt accents. Background neutral warm gray #E7E5E3, charcoal typography #242323, full-width top bar charcoal #232322 with off-white ToolDawn wordmark and navigation. Main active accents tomato red #E95845, occasional cobalt #325BCE for writing tools and pale yellow #E8D887 for small tags. Warm gray is neutral not cream beige brown or orange. Strong graphic composition using product images and crisp line icons, no gradients or atmospheric decorations. Header brand ToolDawn at left, nav '全部工具', '我的作品', '收藏'; right small globe '中文', avatar. Under header tight unframed main area with 28px heading '今天，想完成什么？', wide search input '搜索图片、写作和生活工具' and search icon. Left vertical category rail as simple flat text/icon nav '全部', '图片处理', '文字写作', '日常生活'. Rest of screen is an asymmetric but aligned visual toolkit grid: a wide featured '照片风格转换' tool with a bright real architectural photograph side by side with vivid illustration, compact coral action with arrow; next to it tall '智能抠图' tool with a single distinctive blue sports shoe original and transparent checkerboard cutout. Below a consistent row of four compact tool entries '文章润色', '食物分析', '生日祝福', '图片压缩', each vivid relevant image or carefully typeset Chinese document snippet, unframed visual media plus title and arrow rather than chunky nested cards. One small '常用' red tag. Bottom visible strip '最近作品' with thumbnails and small filenames. Clearly defined controls, deliberate baseline grid, generous gutters, low corner radii no more than 6px, mature approachable identity, no long descriptions or software instructions, no enormous marketing hero, no white empty expanse. Accurate readable Chinese text and exceptionally refined visual art direction for an actual usable utility product.
